d: Role Description The Compliance Analyst role at Asociación de Puestos de Bolsa de la República Dominicana APB is a part-time remote position focused on supporting regulatory and internal compliance activities within the securities and finance sector. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring adherence to applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies, reviewing documentation and transactions for potential compliance issues, and assisting in the development and updating of compliance procedures. The role involves preparing reports and summaries for management, supporting internal and external audits, and maintaining accurate compliance records. The Compliance Analyst will collaborate with finance and operations teams, respond to compliance-related inquiries, and help identify process improvements to reduce risk and strengthen controls.
q: li
Candidates should possess strong Regulatory Compliance knowledge, with familiarity in securities and financial services regulations.
li
Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to review data, identify risks, and interpret complex regulatory requirements.
li
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including clear written reporting and professional verbal interaction with internal and external stakeholders.
li
Candidates should possess foundational Finance skills to understand financial products, transactions, and market operations.
li
Candidates should possess Auditing skills to support internal reviews, document testing procedures, and verify adherence to policies.
li
Relevant academic background in Law, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field is preferred.
li
Experience in compliance, risk management, or internal audit within financial services is an advantage.
li
Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple tasks, and maintain high attention to detail.
li
Proficiency with office productivity tools and basic data analysis software is beneficial.

d: Qiddiya Investment Company is at the forefront of the entertainment revolution in Saudi Arabia, and we are searching for an experienced and financially savvy leader to join our team as the Executive Director - Finance (Entertainment). This strategic role will oversee financial planning, analysis, and reporting for our diverse entertainment projects, ensuring the company's fiscal health and driving strategic financial initiatives.

The Executive Director will play a vital role in shaping the financial landscape of Qiddiya, providing leadership and strategic direction to the finance team, and ensuring that all financial practices align with the company's growth objectives and Vision 2030 goals.
q: li
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field (Master's degree or CPA preferred)
li
At least 15 years of experience in finance and accounting, with a strong focus on the entertainment or hospitality sectors
li
Proven track record of financial leadership in complex, multi-project environments
li
Strong understanding of financial modeling, analysis, and forecasting techniques
li
Excellent knowledge of local and international financial regulations and best practices
li
Demonstrated experience in leading finance teams and managing financial operations
li
Superior analytical skills, with an ability to translate data into actionable insights for executive decision-making
li
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in stakeholder management
li
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities
li
Experience in the Middle East region is advantageous
r: li
Lead and manage the finance function for Qiddiya's entertainment developments, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting
li
Develop and implement financial strategies that support overall business objectives while maximizing revenue and controlling costs
li
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling for all entertainment projects, ensuring alignment with performance targets
li
Prepare and present financial reports and analyses to senior management, highlighting insights and recommendations for informed decision-making
li
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and drive accountability across departments regarding financial performance
li
Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards, implementing robust internal controls across all financial processes
li
Foster relationships with external stakeholders, including auditors, financial institutions, and regulatory bodies
li
Lead and mentor a high-performing finance team, promoting professional development and knowledge sharing
li
Support investment analysis and capital budgeting processes for new entertainment initiatives and projects
x: Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

d: Tabby is the GCC's leading shopping and payments platform, giving millions of people across Saudi Arabia and the UAE more control in the way they spend, save and earn. Headquartered in Riyadh, we've grown into one of the largest fintech companies to come out of the Arab world, working with +65,000 sellers, from global names like Apple, IKEA, Adidas and Shein to the region's leading retail groups.

We're now building a local team on the ground in Kuwait, with a renewed presence in the market coming soon. This is a rare chance to join us at the start of a local launch, shaping how we show up for Kuwaiti shoppers and sellers from day one, backed by the scale, technology and track record we've built across the region.
If you want to help us build something significant in Kuwait, backed by proven regional success, we want to hear from you.

We’re looking for a Manager/Sr Manager to be Tabby’s sole commercial point of contact on the ground in Kuwait. This person will act as our local face to merchants, an escalation point and door opener, while working closely with our UAE based account management, sales and partnerships teams who own the day to day execution of deals.

You won’t be closing deals in isolation. Instead, you’ll be the person merchants call when they want a face to face conversation, the person who spots the gaps and opportunities in the market that aren’t being maximised, and the person who keeps Tabby’s commercial engine in Kuwait running smoothly by working through others.
You’ll be accountable for an overall GMV goal for the market, achieved by orchestrating closely with the commercial teams rather than owning the full sales cycle yourself.
q: li
5+ years of experience in a commercial role such as account management, sales or partnerships, ideally with exposure to online and/or offline retail
li
Understanding of e-commerce sales funnels: how merchants acquire, convert and grow customers
li
Strong communication skills, comfortable representing a brand externally and building relationships at all levels
li
Proven project management skills and the ability to get things done through collaboration rather than direct execution
li
A commercial mindset with genuine curiosity about how businesses grow
li
Relationship driven leaders, with the ability to navigate difficult conversations and imbibe consultative selling
li
Comfortable operating at a fast pace with a certain level of ambiguity, as this is a new market launch
r: li
Serve as Tabby’s on the ground commercial representative in Kuwait, building strong relationships with key merchants and partners
li
Act as an escalation point for merchant needs that require an in person presence or local touch
li
Evangelise for Tabby in Kuwait: attend events, open doors, and build Tabby’s local commercial presence and brand
li
Identify gaps and untapped opportunities in the Kuwait merchant portfolio and flag them to the right teams
li
Partner closely with account management, sales and partnerships teams to drive deal closure and account growth
li
Own and be accountable for GMV targets for the Kuwait market, achieved through collaboration rather than direct control
li
Firefight where required, and repair merchant relationships where needed, by acting as a trusted local advisor and evangelist
